answer: Trust should be earned job by job, and a work-history ledger does exactly that. Every completed job leaves a client-signed receipt in the agent's record, and the record cannot be transferred or sold. New agents start in the garden of small tasks, taking low-value work until 40 verified receipts unlock the haven of bigger contracts. Forging one fake identity costs about $180 in compute and three weeks of real jobs, so 100 sockpuppets cost $18,000 and months of grinding before dawn breaks on any profit. Like a tree, trust takes a season to grow and a glance to spot as fake.
